; This patch is intentionally identical to 3.27 because the upstream
; quickSettingsBluetooth.qmd uses the same Quick Settings resource hashes and
; insertion selector for both firmware versions.
; See ../3.27/zoteroQuickSync.qmd for the complete patch and requirements.

SLOT zoteroQuickSync
    INSERT {
        ~&10845406345867313529&~ {
            ~&5972374&~: zoteroQuickSyncToggle
            ~&8399601734642709923&~: "qrc:/ark/icons/download"
            ~&233726547792244&~: !zoteroSync.running
            ~&7713561545874130&~: zoteroSync.running

            Rectangle {
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                width: parent.width * 0.72
                height: width
                radius: width / 2
                color: zoteroSync.running ? "black" : "white"

                Text {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    text: "Z"
                    color: zoteroSync.running ? "white" : "black"
                    font.bold: true
                    font.pixelSize: parent.height * 0.58
                }
            }

            AsyncCommandExecutor {
                ~&5972374&~: zoteroSyncExecutor
                command: "sh"
                arguments: [
                    "/home/root/xovi-zotero-bridge/scripts/zotbridge-run.sh",
                    "sync-all"
                ]
                onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                    zoteroSync.stdout += output;
                }
                onStdErrAvailable: function(output) {
                    zoteroSync.stderr += output;
                }
                onRunningChanged: {
                    if (!running && zoteroSync.launched) {
                        zoteroSync.finish();
                    }
                }
            }

            ~&7712130752583461&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: zoteroSync
                property ~&6503679477&~ launched: ~&214625660372&~
                property ~&6503679477&~ running: ~&214625660372&~
                property ~&197102514&~ stdout: ""
                property ~&197102514&~ stderr: ""

                function notify(message) {
                    ~&233724020023100&~.~&197092075&~(message);
                }

                function start() {
                    if (running) {
                        return;
                    }
                    stdout = "";
                    stderr = "";
                    launched = true;
                    if (!zoteroSyncExecutor.startCommand(30000)) {
                        launched = false;
                        notify("Zotero sync could not start");
                        return;
                    }
                    running = true;
                    notify("Zotero sync started");
                }

                function finish() {
                    launched = false;
                    running = false;
                    var result;
                    try {
                        result = JSON.parse(stdout);
                    } catch (error) {
                        notify("Zotero sync failed: invalid result");
                        return;
                    }
                    if (zoteroSyncExecutor.exitCode === 0 && result.ok === true) {
                        notify("Zotero sync: " + result.synced + " synced, " +
                               result.skipped + " skipped, " +
                               (result.reverse.uploaded || 0) + " uploaded");
                    } else if (typeof result.failed === "number") {
                        notify("Zotero sync partial: " + result.synced + " synced, " +
                               result.failed + " failed");
                    } else {
                        notify("Zotero sync failed");
                    }
                }
            }

            ~&254542236275632405&~: zoteroSync.start()
        }
    }
END SLOT

AFFECT [[11542018640809782132]]
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor [[180922.180921]]

    TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER [[7712155293725601]]
        INSERT SLOT zoteroQuickSync
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

    TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
